Produced by [[Blooming Nettle]]s, [[Nettle Spore]]s are non-aggressive, but when attacked, they activate [[Spore Explosion]], turning them into a [[Nettle Seedling]].

==Notes==
* These creatures will use [[Spore Explosion]] when attacked, turning themselves into Nettle Seedings. 
** Non-[[attack skill]]s will not trigger the explosion, neither will [[Giriff]] or [[Tekks]] (the [[Asura]] allies who join you in [[Bogroot Growths]]).
** If killed before becoming seedlings, they leave behind an exploitable (but invisible) [[corpse]].
** When they turn into seedlings, they trigger on-[[death]] effects that benefit [[Soul Reaping]] and skills such as [[Assassin's Promise]].
